_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit/wiring.mjs. Each entry names its reason. Origin: Orgpuls allowlist.json @ 6f5d441 (structure only; no entries carried over).

anon_executes.app.k_floor(): the threshold's floor; not secret, a screen shows the range (0001)
anon_executes.app.k_max(): the threshold's ceiling; not secret, a screen shows the range (0001)
anon_executes.app.cutoff_version(): the cut-off version in force; reference data, not secret (0003)
anon_executes.app.is_scan_item(p_item uuid): whether an item belongs to a published scan; the policy that lets a visitor read the scan's items, and no others (0003)
anon_executes.app.submit_scan(p_code text, p_answers j: the scan's one write path, for members without an account (handoff 6.5): checks every answer, caps at the member count, returns ok and a replace key, never an id (0006, CLAUDE.md invariant 4)
anon_executes.app.get_team_view_by_code(p_code text): the team view through the link, for members without an account: levels and labels per theme, only once released at or above k (0006)
anon_executes.app.get_scan_status_by_code(p_code text): the link page's count and closing date: never a score, never a name (handoff 6.4, 0006)
anon_executes.app.get_scan_invite(p_code text): the invite link's page (handoff 6.4, 6.5): the group's name, phase, count, closing date and the version to answer; never a score, never a name; a malformed or unknown code reads nothing (0009)
anon_executes.app.get_invitation(p_token text): the invitation link's page (handoff 6.8): for a holder of the token, the group's name, the invited name, the leader and the state; never the address; an unknown or malformed token reads nothing (0014)
anon_executes.app.invitation_matches(p_token text, p_e: whether an open invitation with this token names this address, asked before a sign-in link may make an account for the invitee; a holder of the token learns only yes or no (0014)
anon_executes.app.download_export(p_token text): the data export's one-time link (handoff 6.18, owner D6): the token is the capability, mailed to the person; it answers the file once within 24 hours and empties it, or a reason (0023)
anon_executes.app.pre_request(): PostgREST's pre-request (db-pre-request), run as the request's role before every request: counts a signed-in person's writes and live events and answers HTTP 429 past the limit; an anon request is not counted and nothing is returned (0021)
anon_executes.app.take_public_rate(p_bucket text, p_ke: the public scan's and sign-in's rate count (handoff 8), keyed by the app's keyed hash of a network or an address (64 hex), so no IP or address is stored and a caller without the app's secret cannot spend another's count; answers seconds to wait (0021)
anon_executes.public.platform_command(p_token text, p_: Sentral's one way in (handoff A.3): the token is the credential, an HS256 JWT for audience leaderpact verified against Vault, at most five minutes long, its id used once; every verified call is audited, refusals included; the command map names each function and scope, and no command reads an answer (0025, D-54)
